errors.text: The hypothesis incorrectly associates all three transitions with the fcc phase; the target assigns the approximately 214 K transition to C14 and the 1084 K and 168 K transitions to fcc.
The cited evidence concerns paramagnetic CoCrFeMnNi and does not substantiate FeCoNiTi antiferromagnetic Ti-sublattice coupling, interfacial pinning, exchange bias, or the reported coercivity.
